name: Python asyncio
description: Concurrent Python with asyncio, from the event loop up.

chapters.title: Transports, Protocols & Futures
chapters.topic: Low-level asyncio: Future objects and loop.create_future, callbacks and add_done_callback, call_soon vs call_soon_threadsafe, transports and protocols (loop.create_connection, loop.create_server, Protocol callbacks connection_made/data_received/connection_lost), flow control with pause_reading and write buffer limits, how streams are built on protocols, subprocesses with asyncio.create_subprocess_exec.
